# F01 frozen-source conversion — blocked derivative

`convertF01(root = process.cwd())` in `convert.ts` returns `{candidate, report}`. The checked-in JSON files are deterministic outputs of that function. It reads the existing v43 source and existing repository raster files; it writes nothing and performs no model, network or browser work.

This is a source-layer conversion, **not** an exact-control PASS, a valid compiler fixture, safety advice newly authored for publication, or reviewed production content. The original v43 files remain the control. `candidate.json` preserves their title, description, questions, answers, ranges, safety statements and capability prose without shortening, paraphrasing or deleting troublesome rows. The candidate is `staged_noindex`, has no approved content date, and is deliberately rejected by the current loader. There is no supplied trusted context and no permission to inject fake approvals to make it pass.

## Evidence

- `source-pins.json`: exact original raw/LF hashes for 23 JSON namespaces, three SVGs, the approved HTML reference and three existing PNGs. Existing v44 input pins are identified separately from newly recorded raster-byte observations. Raster-byte identity is not illustration review or SVG/raster visual equivalence.
- `candidate.json`: the proposed typed F01 shape. Synthetic page/tenant/reference IDs are isolation metadata. `unresolved.*` identifiers and empty prompt/evaluation/illustration-claim lists deliberately represent unavailable evidence.
- `report.json`: every scalar source field with its exact value, file and JSON Pointer; every direct candidate mapping; exact changed values/representations; all additional candidate fields and their basis; historical claim associations explicitly marked unreviewed; existing visual evidence; current schema diagnostics and remaining blockers.

No new imagery is generated. Existing SVG titles/descriptions and PNG bytes/dimensions are reused. Single-text rich AST nodes preserve the visible words and decoded entities, while the source map retains original emphasis, citation-footnote anchors and layout markup. This deliberately does **not** claim full inline/class/theme fidelity. Typed plate classes identify the three source positions; they do not approve any new styling.

## Explicit differences and unresolved conflicts

- Guide §18 requires F01 RELATED absent. The legacy `/no-hot-water` stub is therefore omitted only in the derivative, with its exact source link retained in the report. This difference prevents an exact-control claim.
- The original title is 71 characters and description 174; current bounds are 65/160. The original OG description also differs from the meta description. None is silently rewritten.
- The original provider capability question contains neither “my” nor “your”, which the current schema requires. It is preserved.
- Source ranges with no citation remain present, and source8–11 retain their original `cite:false`. Historical claim/source associations are source-fragment records, not newly verified facts, freshness checks or methodology receipts.
- All nine source capabilities remain `UNVERIFIED` with null production receipts. The nameplate prompt and other preserved prose still make capability claims, so preserving them is not permission to render a live control. Media controls are absent.
- No AC protocol, hazard evaluation, eligibility, prompt, illustration-claim or active-disclosure approval is fabricated. Real controlled records and independent review remain necessary. The disclosure placeholder is never consent.
- CTA references use the existing governed action patterns; the source “right now” suffix and original labels stay in the map. Thermostat maps to the typed `context` packet key; its exact source label and value remain recorded.

The fixture currently records20 schema diagnostics, including branch diagnostics for uncited cause ranges. These are expected failures with explicit evidence, not waived gates. A later scoped derivative may address them with its own source/difference record; it must preserve this control and must not call source amendments exact-control parity.

Run `npx vitest run tests/t6-31.v44-f01-conversion.test.ts --testTimeout=20000` from the repository root. The tests verify regenerated outputs, exhaustive source mapping, unchanged frozen bytes, actual loader refusal, preserved metadata/rows and tamper rejection.
